checks.text: Tourniquet on the bleeding leg within 30 s
checks.why: A large velocity wound to the thigh bleeds out in about 4 minutes. A tourniquet takes 7 s and stops limb bleeding at once; apply it before anything else.

checks.text: Tourniquet before dressings on that leg
checks.why: Massive limb bleeding first gets a tourniquet; dressings come after the bleeding is stopped.

checks.text: All external bleeding stopped within 90 s
checks.why: Bandage the forearm too: every open wound keeps draining blood volume and platelets.
Once bleeding is controlled, treat pain: an awake casualty in severe pain stays tachycardic.

checks.text: Tourniquet not removed while the wound still bleeds
checks.why: Taking the tourniquet off an unbandaged wound restarts the bleed. A combat lifesaver leaves it on for the medic.

checks.requiresText: The leg is not fractured in this variation
checks.why: The gunshot broke the thigh bone. Splint it once the bleeding is controlled.
The casualty must survive to handover.
